metaTitle: Best Round Ottomans for Living Rooms (2026)
metaDescription: Five round ottomans compared on diameter, height, storage, lid type, fill and fabric, with honest notes on tray use, weight limits and small room fit.
expertTake: The Zihanhome 30 in boucle storage ottoman is our top pick because it works as a coffee table, hides blankets and uses solid wood legs under a lift off lid. The SONGMICS 17.7 in linen look ottoman is the value pick for a vanity, a bedside or a small footrest. Skip a round ottoman as your only coffee table if you eat on the sofa often, because the soft top is a poor surface without a tray.
introParagraphs: A round ottoman has no corners to bump, which makes it the friendliest shape for a living room with children or a tight walkway. It works as a footrest, an extra seat, a coffee table with a tray, or a soft center piece in front of a curved sofa.

The choices come down to diameter, height, whether it holds storage and what the top is made of. A large ottoman acts like a table, a small one is a stool, and a stuffed pouf is a footrest and little else. This guide compares five round ottomans and is plain about what each one does well. Because a round shape sheds corners, it also helps a room feel less boxy beside rectangular sofas and tables.

products.name: Zihanhome 30 in Round Boucle Storage Ottoman with Lift Off Lid
products.description:
The Zihanhome is a 30 in round ottoman covered in boucle, with a lift off lid, a storage compartment for blankets and solid wood legs. The listing pitches it as a coffee table as well as an ottoman, and 30 in is the right diameter for a loveseat or a sofa up to about 7 ft. A lift off lid is simpler than a hinged one and has no pinch point.

The tradeoff is the boucle. Looped fabric snags on claws and holds dust, and a pale boucle shows rings from drinks. A soft top is also not a stable surface, so you need a tray to set a mug. Compared with the YUUIJOAA, it has a plainer top and a nubbier fabric. The listing does not give a weight rating in the text we reviewed.

In a real room it sits in front of a sofa with 14 to 18 in of clearance and works well in a room with children because there are no corners. Use a tray, wipe spills at once and brush the loops lightly. After a year, check the lid for sag and the legs for loose bolts, and rotate the lid to spread wear.
products.bestFor: Living rooms that want a soft coffee table with storage and no corners.
pros: 30 in diameter works as a coffee table
Lift off lid has no hinge to pinch or wear
Solid wood legs add stability
Round shape has no corners for children
cons: Soft top needs a tray for drinks

products.name: YUUIJOAA 30 in Round Tufted Storage Ottoman Coffee Table, Flip Top
products.description:
The YUUIJOAA is a 30 in round tufted ottoman with a solid wood frame, a flip up lid and sponge padding under the tufted top. The listing says the top is removable, so you can flip it for a flat side if the product supports it. The tufting breaks up the round shape and gives it a more finished look than a plain pouf.

The tradeoff is that tufted buttons collect crumbs and can come loose, and a flip top lid needs a stable hinge or a clean fit. Compared with the Zihanhome, it has a more formal look but less texture, and the listing gives few details about weight capacity. A solid wood frame is a positive, but check that the legs are secured.

In a real room it fits a living room or a bedroom bench spot, and the storage holds throws and a few remotes. Keep the load balanced on the lid, wipe the fabric gently and check the buttons after a few months. Over a year, the sponge padding on the top compresses where you set things, so rotate the top.
products.bestFor: Rooms that want a more tailored tufted round coffee table with storage.
pros: 30 in solid wood frame suits a coffee table
Tufted top adds a tailored look
Flip up lid opens into storage
Sponge padding cushions the top
cons: Tufted buttons collect crumbs and can loosen
Listing gives little detail on weight limits

products.name: SONGMICS 17.7 in Round Storage Ottoman, Linen Look, Vanity Stool
products.description:
The SONGMICS is a compact round ottoman at 17.7 by 17.7 by 17.5 in, covered in a linen look fabric, with a hidden storage compartment and a frame the listing describes as 1.6 in thick. The size and the 17.5 in height make it a seat or a footrest, and it also works as a vanity stool. The related listings from the same maker are available in synthetic leather and velvet.

The tradeoff is scale. At 17.7 in wide, it holds a few blankets at most, and it is too small to be a coffee table. The frame is MDF, which is solid for its size but can chip at the edges if dropped. Compared with the 30 in ottomans, it is a stool and not a table. A linen look fabric is a polyester that resists wear better than a true linen.

In a real room it sits beside an armchair or in a bedroom or an entry, where it holds a throw. Open the lid carefully, keep the load low and wipe the fabric with a damp cloth. After a year, check the lid hinge or lift mechanism, and avoid standing on it.
products.bestFor: Vanities, bedsides and small footrest jobs with light storage.
pros: 17.5 in height matches a standard seat
Compact size fits tight spaces
Hidden storage for a throw
MDF frame is solid for its size
cons: Too small to act as a coffee table

products.name: Asuprui 20 in Round Foam Filled Pouf Ottoman, 14 in High
products.description:
The Asuprui is a 20 by 20 by 14 in round pouf filled with high density foam under a plush fiber cover, and the listing describes the 20 in width as roomy enough for both legs and feet. A foam filled pouf is a soft footrest and an occasional floor seat. It has no frame, no lid and no storage.

The tradeoff is height. At 14 in, it sits below a standard 17 in seat, so it works as a footrest for a reclined posture but not as a seat for an adult at a table. Compared with the SONGMICS, it is softer and lighter, and it cannot hold anything inside. The plush cover collects pet hair and dust, and foam fill compresses over time.

In a real room it moves around easily, and it fits in front of a chair, a bed or a kid's play area. Fluff it often, and spot clean the cover. A year in, expect the top to flatten where feet rest, and rotate it to even the wear.
products.bestFor: A soft, light footrest that moves between rooms.
pros: High density foam fill gives soft support
20 in width fits both feet
Light and easy to move
Plush cover feels warm
cons: 14 in height is low for upright seating
Plush cover collects hair and flattens

products.name: BSHOMGI Round Corduroy Ottoman Coffee Table, Removable Cover, 200 lb
products.description:
The BSHOMGI is a round corduroy ottoman with a removable cover, plush foam filling, non slip rubber pads and a stated capacity of 200 lb. The listing mentions two sizes, a 32 in and a 24 in, so you can choose between a table and a smaller seat. A removable cover is the most practical feature for cleaning and replacing fabric.

The tradeoff is that the listing is a floor level piece with foam and no storage. The 200 lb rating is a listing claim, and a foam body gives soft support but not a hard surface. Corduroy is durable and hides wear, but it collects lint. Compared with the Zihanhome, it has no lid and no hidden space, but the cover can be washed.

In a real room it works as a low coffee table or a floor seat, and the rubber pads keep it from sliding on a hard floor. Use a tray for drinks and spot clean the cover or follow its care tag. After a year, expect the foam to soften and the shape to relax, and check the pads for wear.
products.bestFor: Families who want a washable cover and a soft floor level table.
pros: Removable cover can be cleaned
Non slip rubber pads grip the floor
Stated 200 lb capacity covers seating
Corduroy hides wear
cons: Foam body softens and relaxes over time

buyingCriteria.explanation: A 30 in round suits a coffee table in front of a loveseat or a sofa up to about 7 ft. A 17 to 20 in ottoman is a footrest or a stool. A coffee table should be about two thirds of the sofa length and 14 to 18 in away from it. The Zihanhome and YUUIJOAA are both 30 in, and the SONGMICS is 17.7 in. In a small room, a 24 in size or less keeps a 30 in walkway on one side, which matters more than the extra tabletop.

An ottoman should be within about 1 in of the sofa seat height, which is 16 to 18 in. The SONGMICS at 17.5 in fits, while the Asuprui at 14 in is lower. A low ottoman suits a recliner posture and is awkward at a table. If the ottoman will also be a seat for a child, a lower height around 14 in is actually comfortable.

A framed storage ottoman gives a flat top and hidden space. A pouf is soft and light, but cannot hold a tray safely. A lift off lid, as on the Zihanhome, has no hinge, and flip top lids need a good hinge. Choose the type by what you will put on top. A removable lid also helps you reach items stored underneath without moving a tray, and some people prefer that to a flip top.

High density foam keeps its shape longer than loose fill. Sponge on a tufted top compresses where you set things. Cheap foam softens within a year or two. If the ottoman is a footrest, softness is fine, and if it is a table, you want a firmer top. A firm top is easier to set a tray on, while a soft top is kinder to bare feet, so decide which job comes first.

Boucle and corduroy hide wear but collect lint and snag. Linen look fabrics are usually polyester and wipe clean. Removable covers, like the BSHOMGI, can be washed. Light colors show rings and stains. A washable cover is worth real money in a house with children, since fabric rings and crayon do not come out of fixed upholstery.

Stated loads such as 200 lb allow seating, but do not stand on it. A solid wood frame, as listed for the YUUIJOAA, is steadier than thin MDF. Non slip pads help on hard floors. Check the legs for secure bolts. Tip the ottoman gently once it arrives and check for any wobble, since a rocking base is hard to fix later.

howWeEvaluated.title: Listing specifications
howWeEvaluated.description: We evaluated each ottoman from the diameter, height, fill and lid type on its Amazon listing. We did not handle any of these ottomans. Where a listing omitted a number, such as weight capacity on the Zihanhome, we said so.

howWeEvaluated.title: Fit and function
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared diameters with sofa lengths and clearances, and heights with seat heights. The 30 in models work as tables and the smaller ones as stools. We flagged low heights. We also noted that a round coffee table seats the same number of knees but takes less floor than a rectangle.

howWeEvaluated.title: Lid and storage design
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at lift off, flip top and pouf styles and the wear points of each. We noted that soft tops need a tray. We considered storage depth for blankets.

howWeEvaluated.title: Owner feedback patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We reviewed recurring concerns for round ottomans, such as sagging tops, loose legs, fabric snags and odor. We did not repeat ratings. Those patterns shaped the cons.

howWeEvaluated.title: Distinct lineup
howWeEvaluated.description: We chose round ottomans that differ in size, fill and storage, and left out leather ottomans, which have their own guide. We excluded sets of nesting poufs. Relative price tiers only set the order.

cards.label: Storage ottoman
cards.text: The Zihanhome, YUUIJOAA and SONGMICS hide blankets and give a flat top. They cost more and are heavier.

cards.label: Pouf
cards.text: The Asuprui and BSHOMGI are soft and light but hold nothing inside.

howToChoose.note: Choose storage if the living room is cluttered, and a pouf for a pure footrest.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A round shape with no corners, a height near the seat and a size that leaves 30 in of walkway.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: Every ottoman here is round, and the SONGMICS and Asuprui take the least floor. None of them is a substitute for a side table beside the sofa.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want a table with solid wood legs and a lid that holds a tray steady.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You only want a footrest, where the Asuprui is enough.

maintenance.why: Boucle and corduroy collect lint and dust. Use a soft attachment and avoid pulling loops.
Blot with a damp cloth and mild soap, following the care tag. A removable cover can be washed.
Legs and hinges loosen with use. Tighten bolts and look for lid sag. A drop of wood glue in a loose leg hole, followed by a bolt tighten, often cures a wobble.
Rotating spreads wear and keeps the top from dimpling where you set things.
Pouf foam compresses and needs a reshape. Pat and turn it over.

faq.q: Can a round ottoman be a coffee table?
faq.a: Yes, a 30 in model like the Zihanhome works, but add a tray because a soft top is unstable for drinks. A lipped wooden tray also hides the seam where a lid meets the base.
Choose about two thirds of your sofa length for a table, and 17 to 20 in for a footrest. Leave 14 to 18 in of clearance. Measure the sofa first, then pick the diameter, not the other way around.

faq.q: Is a storage ottoman better than a pouf?
faq.a: Storage ottomans hide clutter and offer a flat top. Poufs are softer and lighter. Choose by what you need.

faq.q: How much weight can they hold?
faq.a: Check the listing. The BSHOMGI states 200 lb. If no rating is given, treat the ottoman as a footrest and not as seating.
Yes, claws and zippers can pull loops. A tight fabric or a darker color hides wear better.

faq.q: How do I clean a round ottoman?
faq.a: Vacuum, blot spills and follow the care tag. A removable cover can be washed, and other covers should be spot cleaned only. Avoid steam or harsh stain removers on tufted tops, which can lift the buttons.
